main_body: Thatched hip roof (rows 4-53) over a plank-wall hut front with a recessed doorway, round shield ornaments and a stone footing
top_band: Golden thatch roof slope, rows ~4-53, light-to-mid yellow courses with dark course lines. It ends at a dark eave line over the wall at rows ~50-55.
evidence: The roof is a large foreshortened slope seen from above, with flared hip edges at the sides. Below it, the dark eave band shades the vertical plank wall. The door has a framed, inset dark interior and a lighter stone threshold. The roof surface and the wall are both clearly drawn, as in the Beodeul house references.

style.evidence: The thatch has about 5 tones (dark brown, ochre, gold, light, highlight), with a per-course tick texture and dark brown lines between courses. Outlines are dark brown, tinted to match the thatch and wood, not black. The wall planks have several brown tones and the stone footing is speckled. The door interior is a large dark area but has some gradient. Overall it is close to the reference in richness, only slightly simpler in the wall and door areas.
